roadmap_name: KKAM BOOKS practical digital product roadmap
principles: Sell finished, immediately usable tools rather than generic information alone.
Each product must solve a specific recurring problem for a clearly defined buyer.
Use original or properly licensed assets and preserve source evidence.
Do not invent sales figures or treat social-media claims as verified demand.
No product may be marked approved or published without human approval.

products.title: Freelancer Business Dashboard
products.product_brief: A ready-to-use business control pack for tracking clients, leads, projects, invoices, income, expenses and weekly priorities.
products.product_description: A practical printable system for keeping client work and business finances organised. Final contents and claims require review.
acceptance_checks: All tracker fields are labelled and usable when printed
Include an example completed row and a blank version where helpful
Check arithmetic examples and date fields
Print test at 100 percent scale

products.title: 90-Day Life Organisation Planner
products.audience: Adults seeking a structured personal reset
products.product_brief: A guided 90-day system with goal definition, weekly planning, habit tracking, reflection and progress reviews.
products.product_description: A structured printable planner for turning broad goals into weekly actions and reviewing progress.
acceptance_checks: Provide 13 weekly planning/review cycles or explain the 90-day structure
Avoid medical or guaranteed-outcome claims
Ensure writing space is practical
Check all dates and instructions for consistency

products.title: One-Person Business Operating System
products.audience: Solo business owners and microbusiness operators
products.product_brief: A lightweight operations pack containing folder architecture, recurring checklists, SOP templates, decision logs and weekly review pages.
products.product_description: A practical framework for documenting repeatable tasks and reducing operational clutter.
acceptance_checks: Every checklist has a clear trigger and completion state
SOP template includes owner, steps, tools and revision date
Folder structure is platform-neutral
No promise of specific revenue or productivity results

products.title: Complete Printable Planner Bundle
products.audience: People who want a coordinated set of printable planning tools
products.product_brief: A curated, non-repetitive bundle of daily, weekly, monthly, habit, goal, project and budget pages with consistent visual design.
products.product_description: A coordinated set of printable pages covering distinct planning needs; page count and final contents must be verified before listing.
acceptance_checks: Maintain a page inventory and deduplicate near-identical pages
Include both ink-light and readable versions where practical
Test writing space and print margins
Ensure cover, contents page and actual page count agree

products.title: Software Quick-Start Toolkit
products.audience: Beginners using one selected software product
products.product_brief: A focused starter kit for a single software product, with setup checklist, workflow templates, troubleshooting prompts and a quick reference sheet.
products.product_description: A concise, practical starter kit. The software target must be selected and current interface details verified before production.
acceptance_checks: Name the target software and version/date scope before writing
Verify each step against official documentation
Clearly distinguish independent product from official affiliation
Do not include credentials, private data or unsupported features

products.title: Ready-to-Use Message Scripts
products.audience: Freelancers, small businesses and customer-facing professionals
products.product_brief: Editable message templates for enquiries, follow-ups, quotations, delays, complaints, boundaries, payment reminders and client handovers.
products.product_description: A copy-and-customise library of professional communication scripts for common business situations.
acceptance_checks: Provide placeholders and brief usage notes
Include polite, direct and warm variants for high-frequency cases
Avoid deceptive, coercive or legally definitive wording
Test copyability and ensure no real personal data appears

products.title: Original Character Design Toolkit
products.audience: Beginner illustrators, writers and independent creators
products.product_brief: A character-development workbook with profile sheets, silhouette exploration, expression grids, pose planning, colour notes and consistency checks.
products.product_description: A practical workbook for developing and documenting original characters with reusable design sheets.
acceptance_checks: Use original artwork or assets with documented commercial rights
Include usable blank drawing space and clear labels
Do not copy protected characters or imitate a living artist on request
Check line weight and print contrast
